item.title: 🟠 Critical SharePoint RCE flaw exploited to steal machine keys
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Hackers are actively exploiting the critical CVE-2026-50522 vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint to steal machine keys and maintain access even after affected servers are patched. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 9h ago

item.title: 🔴 Anubis ransomware claims Coca-Cola Fairlife attack, threatens data leak
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
The Anubis ransomware gang has claimed responsibility for the cyberattack on Coca-Cola's Fairlife dairy subsidiary, threatening to publish allegedly stolen corporate data unless the company pays a ransom. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 10h ago
